title: fix: award 5 Pollen for 3 Paid Pollen of app usage
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Lowers the external Paid-Pollen app milestone from 10 to 3 Pollen spent and raises its reward from 3 to 5 Pollen.
- Updates quest progress and dashboard copy. Keeps the existing quest ID and earned rewards to prevent duplicate payouts.
- Leaves the ten-connected-users reward at 3 Pollen and the first-connection quest retired. No additional Tinybird changes.
- Verified: 39 quest tests, TypeScript and Biome; tests cover 2.99, 3 and 3.01 Paid Pollen and preservation of already-earned rewards.

Follow-up to #14950. Deploy/backfill its Tinybird changes before promoting Enter.

gist.headline: A smaller bloom, more pollen
gist.blurb: The app-growth garden now blooms after 3 Paid Pollen of usage, and the harvest is 5 Pollen. Existing rewards stay safely where they landed; no double-dipping in this flowerbed.
gist.summary: The external Paid-Pollen app-growth milestone now awards 5 Pollen after an app spends 3 Paid Pollen instead of awarding 3 Pollen after 10, while retaining the existing quest ID and previously earned rewards.
gist.impact: App builders can reach the Paid-Pollen usage reward sooner and receive 5 Pollen, while already-completed quests remain preserved without duplicate payouts.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a cheerful gardener measuring a small code-plant that has reached a clearly marked 3-Pollen milestone, where five glowing Pollen seeds are ready to harvest. A cozy quest dashboard or retro terminal confirms the reward, with an already-collected basket kept intact to represent preserved earned rewards.
